/-- For primes p, t 2 p = p - 1. -/
lemma t_two_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) : t 2 p = p - 1 := by
  have hpos : 0 < p := Nat.Prime.pos hp
  have hp2 : 0 < p - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.Prime.one_lt hp)
  have hprod : p ∣ ∏ i ∈ range 2, ((p - 1) + i) := by
    change p ∣ (p - 1) * (p - 1 + 1)
    have heq : p - 1 + 1 = p := Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.Prime.one_lt hp)
    rw [heq]
    simp [Nat.dvd_mul_right]
  have hlt : ∀ m ∈ range (p - 1), 0 < m → ¬(p ∣ ∏ i ∈ range 2, (m + i)) := by
    intro m hm hposm
    have hm_lt : m < p - 1 := Nat.mem_range.mpr hm
    have hprod_eq : ∏ i ∈ range 2, (m + i) = m * (m + 1) := by
      simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, add_assoc]
    rw [hprod_eq]
    have hnotdvd : ¬ p ∣ m * (m + 1) := by
      by_contra! hdvd
      have hdvd1 : p ∣ m := Nat.Prime.dvd_mul.mp hdvd |>.resolve_left (by
        exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (hposm) (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hm_lt (Nat.le_sub_right_of_add_le (by omega))))
      have hdvd2 : p ∣ (m + 1) := by
        have hle : m + 1 ≤ p - 1 := by omega
        interval_cases (p - 1) <;> simp_all [Nat.Prime]
        <;> omega
      have hlt1 : m < p := by omega
      have hlt2 : m + 1 < p := by omega
      exact (Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_mul _ hdvd1).ne (by
        exact Nat.dvd_of_dvd_mul (by simp [Nat.dvd_one]) hdvd2) (by omega)
    exact hnotdvd
  have h := t_eq_of p 2 (p - 1) hp2 hprod hlt
  exact h
